english: Communicating, and keeping that most holy day, on which (keeping that most holy night, in which) the spotless virginity of the blessed Mary brought forth a Saviour to this world; and also reverencing the memory first of the same glorious Mary, ever a virgin, mother of the same our God and Lord Jesus Christ; likewise of Thy blessed Apostles and Martyrs, Peter and Paul, Andrew, James, John, Thomas, James, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Simon and Thaddeus, Linus, Cletus, Clement, Xystus, Cornelius, Cyprian, Lawrence, Chrysogonus, John and Paul, Cosmas and Damian, and of all Thy Saints; by whose merits and prayers grant that in all things we may be defended by the help of Thy protection. Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.
